text:
Priya Rao: :loudspeaker: FYI team — were publishing a consolidated Private/VPC on-prem compliance onboarding checklist for SOC2/FedRAMP customers. This bundles preflight, evidence collection, and optional SRE assistance. Summary below.

Elena Torres: Nice. Is this replacing the old separate checklists?

Priya Rao: Its a superset — single checklist that branches by regime (SOC2 vs FedRAMP). Includes: installer preflight, KMS/HSM guidance, network segmentation verification, and audit log configuration.

Asha Patel: Key compliance points: evidence templates, retention defaults, and required roles for attestations. Also adds a mapping matrix to controls (e.g., CC6, IA-5).

Jordan Lee: Customer impact? How do CS and Sales use this during onboarding?

Priya Rao: CS will use a checklist flow in the onboarding portal. Sales can attach a compliance readiness badge to deals once preflight is green. Theres an SRE-assisted onboarding SKU for complex HSM/air-gapped setups.

Marcus Li: Ops notes: preflight commands included for runtime checks. Example: 

```
redwoodctl onprem preflight --cluster CLUSTER_ID --profile compliance
# returns: network_ok: true, kms_status: hsm-present, audit_ready: true
```

Asha Patel: Evidence capture: we provide a zip of templated artifacts customers can download and sign. Retention of evidence artifacts configurable; default 90 days.

Elena Torres: Installer additions: a compliance-mode flag that runs extra validations and emits a JSON report. Example: 

```
redwoodctl onprem install --cluster CLUSTER_ID --compliance-mode SOC2
# writes: /var/lib/redwood/compliance-report.json
```

Infra Bot: Compliance checklist draft published: https://docs.internal.redwood/onprem/compliance-checklist-2026 (internal).

Jordan Lee: Action items for CS: add a short FAQ, and a template email for customers starting SOC2/FedRAMP onboarding. Ill draft and tag Asha for review.

Priya Rao: Engineering: integrate preflight outputs into Console onboarding flow (Marcus). Docs: finalize matrix + evidence templates (Elena). Security/Compliance: approval of artifact templates (Asha). Ops: prepare SRE-assist runbook (Marcus).

Asha Patel: Note for FedRAMP: HSM workflows differ for air-gapped installs; include explicit manual steps and SRE-assisted offer. Ill add the control mappings tonight.

Marcus Li: Monitoring: add an onboarding dashboard with per-customer preflight status and outstanding items. Will wire alerts for failed preflight checks.

Jordan Lee: CS draft link: https://docs.internal.redwood/cs/onboarding-templates/compliance-email-draft. Pinging Asha for legal/compliance language.

Priya Rao: Timeline: checklist GA internal next week, customer-facing docs and portal flows in two weeks. Please escalate any blocker in #eng-security.

Elena Torres: Will update installer and docs PRs today.

Infra Bot: Onboarding checklist GA event scheduled: 2026-10-05T16:00Z. Calendar invite sent.

Priya Rao: Thanks all — this should make audits much smoother for customers. Closing announcement; reopen if exec wants a broader comms push.
